about_the_game:
Anomalous Assault is an exhilarating 2D roguelite that plunges you into a procedurally generated facility teeming with danger. As a clone, you're reborn after every death, determined to advance further each time. Utilize 3D printing stations and gather resources to upgrade your equipment and discover new gear. Battle against soldiers, zombies, and other anomalous entities in a relentless fight for survival. Experience a game where strategy, skill, and determination are key to progressing through this ever-changing and challenging world.

Key Features:

  • Endless Variety: Procedurally generated levels ensure a unique and unpredictable experience with every run, keeping the gameplay fresh and exciting.

  • Clone Resurrection Mechanic: Death is not the end. Each time you fall, a new clone takes your place, learning from past attempts to push further into the facility.

  • 3D Printing Stations: Gather resources during your runs to print powerful upgrades and new gear, enhancing your abilities and chances of survival.

  • Diverse Enemy Types: Confront a wide range of adversaries, from soldiers and zombies to other mysterious anomalies, each with distinct behaviors and challenges.

  • Single-Player Adventure: Immerse yourself in a thrilling solo journey where your strategic planning and quick reflexes are constantly put to the test.

This game was built using RevoltGPT — an AI-powered development platform.
